high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news headline and accompanying text. The headline reads: "Omar Abdullah to become J&K CM, says Farooq Abdullah." This suggests that Farooq Abdullah has made a statement indicating that Omar Abdullah will be appointed as the Chief Minister (CM) of Jammu and Kashmir (J&K). Below the headline, there is additional text that states: "JKNC is at present leading in 41 seats, official data from ECI said." This indicates that the Jammu and Kashmir National Conference (JKNC), which is likely the political party represented by Omar Abdullah, is currently leading
